page.notes: The woodcut initial "A" is joined to "NNVS" as "ANNVS". The title block is set in large capitals and roman type; the lines of the salutation and the first paragraph alternate between italic and roman, and the italic/roman boundaries in the middle lines are uncertain, so they are marked by impression only. The "c" mark at top right and the pale catch-mark at the right edge are not printed text and are omitted. The "S.D." greeting is set as its own paragraph per the letter rules. "inclyto" and "tempore" are read from the scan without certainty about the exact diacritics; "tĕpore" and similar small marks are normalised. No margin notes are present.
